_comment: Template for the digital-partition klt lvs request (T1 item 4, Digital). scripts/lvs-regen.sh fills <GATE_SPICE> and <POSTROUTE_V> with the newest place-and-route record's paths and writes the result beside the report in layout/digital/lvs-records/<date>-<sha>/lvs.request.json. VDD/VSS are the SG13G2 standard-cell PG pin names, read from the extracted layout and the PDK cell SPICE (power_pins in the report).
